data.name: Sudish
data.gender_notes: Sudish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sud means good and Dish means virtuous or auspicious. It is a name that signifies a person who is good and virtuous in nature. The name Sudish carries the meaning “Good, virtuous, auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sudish usually hope their child will grow to embody good, virtuous, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sudish is a name that reflects the inner virtues and good qualities of a person. It is a name that is often given to a child who is believed to have the potential to grow up to be a good and virtuous person.
data.etymology: Sudish belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, virtuous, auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sudish total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
